about: The engineer’s reading of every correction the second model proposed that passed the mechanical and glossary checks (and so went on to LanguageTool, Hunspell and the meaning check). decision: adopt or reject; note: why. Only a correction that survived the tools AND is marked adopt here was applied. The reader was a language model (the engineer doing this work), not a native speaker. Written 2026-11-16.

battle.titleA.note: Half of the heading 'Arena di battaglia', Italian order.

device.swell.name.note: A device's name; vaga (a great wave, literary) is the game's choice, and crescendo is another device's idea.

nav.toggleAudio.note: A label read out for a toggle button; 'turn on or off' is what it does.

auth.nudgeBody.note: The English repeats 'one … only' too; a rewording of a correct sentence.

verdict.notUsed.note: usadas and utilizadas are both correct.

verdict.missed.note: Changes the meaning: 'missed' is a bonus not landed, not a curse not fulfilled.

theatre.declined.note: Changes the meaning: a device that declines a session may support it.

theatre.judgedRules.note: rodando is the ordinary Brazilian word for a program running.

theatre.cursesYou.note: Deliberate: Portuguese goes on in lower case after a colon, so the rule, a full sentence, follows a full stop (commit 3bfe45e).
